rows.Normal value: Two attributes. throttle-time indicates the amount of time in ms the client was throttled. Ideally = 0. byte-rate indicates the data produce/consume rate of the client in bytes/sec. For (user, client-id) quotas, both user and client-id are specified. If per-client-id quota is applied to the client, user is not specified. If per-user quota is applied, client-id is not specified.

For (user, client-id) quotas, both user and client-id are specified. If per-client-id quota is applied to the client, user is not specified. If per-user quota is applied, client-id is not specified.
